dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noTransactions: No transactions yet. Add income to get started.
dashboard.noGoals: No active goals. Create one to start tracking.

funds.deleteExpenseDesc: This returns {amount} to the {fund} fund. The ledger keeps a record of both the original expense and the reversal.
funds.analyticsUnavailable: Spending analytics aren't ready for this fund yet. If this persists, the analytics data needs to be rebuilt.

income.title: Income
income.addIncomeSubtitle: Income is automatically distributed: 33% each to Stability, Growth, and Life + 1% to Charity.
income.noteBaseRequired: Splitting into whole {base} {currency} notes is on, so the amount must be a multiple of {base} — the closest is {nearest}. To enter any amount, turn that setting off in Settings.
income.failedToast: Failed to add income. Please try again.
income.deleteIncomeDesc: This removes {amount} and pulls each fund's share back out. It only works if none of it has been spent yet. The ledger records the reversal.

goals.title: Goals
goals.noActiveGoals: No active goals. Create your first goal to start tracking.
goals.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Buy a gift for my wife
goals.progressNote: Progress is calculated dynamically from the fund's current balance. No money is locked or transferred to this goal.
goals.deleteGoalDesc: This permanently removes the goal. Your funds and their balances are not affected — goals never held money.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.subtitle: Move funds between your four funds
transfers.undoDesc: This moves {amount} back from {to} to {from}. Both funds are restored and the ledger records the reversal.

reports.title: Reports
reports.notEnough: Not enough activity to draw conclusions.
reports.fundHealthDesc: How much each fund received versus spent this period. Utilization over 100% means the fund spent more than it took in.
reports.whereMoneyWentDesc: Every expense category this period, ranked by total spend.
reports.insightNoActivity: No activity recorded in this period.
reports.insightSavedPositive: You kept {pct}% of your income — a positive savings rate this period.
reports.insightSpentMore: You spent more than you earned this period: outgoings exceeded income by {pct}%.
reports.insightOverspentFund: Your {fund} fund spent more than it received — over by its incoming amount, at {pct}% utilization.
reports.insightBestFund: {fund} is your best-managed fund — you used only {pct}% of what it received.
reports.insightTopCategory: Your biggest expense category was {category} ({fund}), at {pct}% of all spending.
reports.insightCharity: You gave {pct}% of your income to charity this period.
reports.insightSpendingUp: Spending is up {pct}% versus the previous {days} days.
reports.insightSpendingDown: Spending is down {pct}% versus the previous {days} days.
reports.roscaDesc: Money that moved through your savings groups this period. Not counted as income, spending, or savings — over a full cycle it nets to zero.

charity.subtitle: Giving & charitable contributions (1%)
charity.deleteDesc: This returns {amount} to the charity fund. The ledger keeps a record of both the donation and the reversal.

auth.name: Full Name
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your THULUTH account
auth.createSubtitle: Start managing your wealth with THULUTH

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account and preferences
settings.roundToNoteBaseDesc: The smallest note in circulation is {base}, so every fund's share is a whole number of notes — and income must be entered in multiples of {base}. Turn this off to split down to the exact dinar.
settings.categoriesDesc: Customise the categories offered when you add an expense to each fund. Renaming one updates every expense recorded under it; removing one never changes expenses you already recorded.
settings.roscaDesc: Track a سلفة: a fixed monthly contribution, and one round where the whole pot comes to you. Contributions aren't counted as spending and payouts aren't counted as income.

pwa.installDescription: Add THULUTH to your device for a faster, full-screen, app-like experience.
pwa.installIOS: Tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen" to install THULUTH.
pwa.updateDescription: A new version of THULUTH is ready.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: THULUTH can't reach the network right now. Check your connection and try again — your data is safe.

rosca.title: ROSCA
rosca.subtitle: {active} active · {amount} committed each month
rosca.memberCountHint: How many people are in the group — also how many rounds it runs.
rosca.fundHint: Contributions leave this fund and your payout returns to it.
rosca.alreadyStartedHint: Turn this on if you joined before you started tracking here.
rosca.priorHint: Recorded so your position is right. Neither amount is taken from or added to your funds — that money moved before you started tracking here.
rosca.payoutRoundHint: Leave empty if the draw hasn't happened — you can set it later.
rosca.noGroupsHint: Add a group to track what you pay in and when the pot comes to you.
rosca.disabledHint: Turn it on in Settings to track rotating savings groups.
rosca.turnNotDrawnHint: Leave this until the draw happens — you can't record a payout before it's set.
rosca.turnBeforeTracking: Your turn was round {round}, before you started tracking. The {amount} you collected is already counted in this group.
rosca.payoutAmountHint: Pre-filled with the expected total. Change it if the real amount differed.
rosca.payoutUnavailable: Set your turn first to record a payout.
rosca.payoutNotRecorded: All {count} rounds are paid, but your payout isn't recorded.
rosca.priorPositionNote: Rounds before {round} were settled before you started tracking here. They count towards your position but never moved money in this app.
rosca.scheduleDesc: Worked out from the start date. Mark each round once you've paid it.
rosca.undoContributionDesc: This returns {amount} to your {fund} fund and marks round {round} unpaid.
rosca.undoPayoutDesc: This takes {amount} back out of your {fund} fund and marks your payout unrecorded.
rosca.netPositionDesc: What you've received minus what you've paid in. Over a full cycle this comes back to zero — a ROSCA is neither income nor spending.
rosca.closeGroupDesc: Marks the cycle finished. Nothing is refunded and no entries change — you can reopen it later.
rosca.leaveGroupDesc: Use this if you left part-way through. Everything you recorded stays exactly as it is — nothing is refunded, because that money really did move.
rosca.notCountedNote: Contributions aren't counted as spending and payouts aren't counted as income.
